motivation: The frozen round-6 disease-only comparison found PSAN below the dense and free low-rank controls. PSAN had selected c1 and both controls c2, and the disease-only runs received 42% of the optimizer steps of the 11-class runs, all of them peaking in their last epoch. This check trains all three arms with c2 and with as many optimizer steps as the 11-class 30-epoch runs.
prior_exposure: all round-2 to round-6 test results, including the round-6 disease-only test results
unchanged: data (round-6 disease-only split and labels), sampler, augmentation, optimizer, EMA, gradient clipping, checkpoint rule and training loop of experiments.round6.train

statistics.ci: crossed group x seed bootstrap across seeds 42-44
statistics.correction: Holm within the post hoc family

concurrency: one job per GPU in addition to the round-6 workers
